prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / watercolor style transfer. Create a square head-and-shoulders artistic portrait of Ahimanikya Satapathy. Image 1 is the user-supplied photograph and the SOLE source of identity. Image 2 is ONLY the approved painting medium reference; do not borrow its face or clothing. Preserve his exact facial geometry and proportions, mature age, medium-brown complexion, short side-parted dark hair with gray temples, direct slightly raised gaze, relaxed closed smile, clean-shaven face with natural subtle stubble, and dark olive collared button shirt. Keep his real expression and asymmetry, eye and nose shape, cheek and jaw structure, natural skin texture. No beautifying, skin lightening, de-aging, glasses or accessories. Crop from the supplied upper body to head and shoulders; preserve the visible shirt color/collar/buttons, do not invent costume. Remove the window/interior scenery and replace with warm ivory cotton paper #F5EFDF, restrained teal, ochre and laterite watercolor washes behind the shoulders. Face realistic and recognizable, soft watercolor and delicate graphite only at edges; shoulders dissolve into paper. Center with breathing space around the hair for the established author portrait frame. No text, symbols or other objects.
review: Visually compared with supplied photograph: direct slightly raised gaze, closed smile, facial proportions, short side-parted hair with gray temples and olive collared shirt retained. Watercolor warmth and fine paper/skin texture interpretive; no material identity drift observed. Independent subject review pending.
